query:
UPDATE tags SET
              name = COALESCE(?, name),
              color = COALESCE(?, color),
              updated_at = unixepoch()
           WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?
           RETURNING id as "id!: Uuid", name, color,
                     created_at as "created_at: EpochUtc",
                     updated_at as "updated_at: EpochUtc"
